purpose: Bounded numerical and ephemeris provenance audit of the frozen Apophis 2029 teacher branch; not an operational forecast test
old_ephemeris: data/raw/horizons/body_*.json plus stored apophis_earth_2029_* refinement for Earth/Moon
teacher_asteroid: data/raw/horizons/asteroid_99942.json plus stored refined Apophis rows
ng_gate: nominal header parameters are retained as a teacher-matching branch; availability is reported from ng_inputs_v2 and is not inferred from osculating epoch or solution date

protocol.reference: immutable old Apophis daily series with the stored 5-minute Earth/Moon/Apophis rows merged only inside the 36-hour window
protocol.evaluation: all solver outputs are sampled on the same old daily-plus-refined TDB grid; accepted integration endpoints are retained separately
protocol.axis_a: RK4 step scales versus independent Dormand-Prince 5(4) tolerances with identical force callback and old merged ephemerides
protocol.axis_b: old merged daily/refined ephemerides versus development30 hourly ephemerides for all nine configured planets with identical nominal NG/J2 force branch; RK4 scales 0.5/0.25 and DP tight/tighter are compared
protocol.no_future_inputs: the teacher state is used only for audit errors; no future asteroid state or reference-derived feature enters force evaluation
protocol.interpretation: solver agreement bounds numerical sensitivity; source shifts bound ephemeris/interpolation sensitivity; neither identifies omitted physics
protocol.checkpoint_policy: completed case checkpoints are atomic and reused only when config and source fingerprints match
